experience_section.title: A Waterfall Swim and a Volcanic Soak, in One Private Day
experience_section.intro: At the base of Rincon de la Vieja Volcano, the Rio Negro carves through forest and volcanic rock to form Oropendola Waterfall, a striking cascade into a crystal-clear swimming pool, and a string of natural hot spring pools warmed by the volcano below. This private half-day tour combines both in one relaxed, easy-access outing.

items.title: Oropendola Waterfall
items.description: A waterfall dropping into a crystal-clear pool set in a rock canyon, one of Guanacaste's most photographed swimming spots.

items.title: Rio Negro Hot Springs
items.description: A series of natural hot spring pools built along the riverbank, warmed by the geothermal activity of Rincon de la Vieja Volcano.

items.title: Easy Access, Real Nature
items.description: Short, easy walking access to both sites, no technical hiking required, set in Guanacaste's dry forest at the base of the volcano.

items.title: A Relaxed Introduction to Rincon de la Vieja
items.description: A gentler, wellness-focused alternative to the full national park hike, ideal for families and travelers who want the waterfall and hot springs without a long trek.

footer.title: Nature and Wellness at the Base of a Volcano
footer.text: Swim beneath a waterfall, then soak in mineral-rich hot spring pools warmed by the same volcano, an easy, relaxed private day for travelers of every age.

before_you_arrive: Bring a swimsuit, towel and a change of clothes, you'll be in the water at both stops.
Water shoes or sandals with grip are recommended, the terrain around the pools is natural rock.
Apply reef-safe sunscreen and insect repellent before departure.
The waterfall pool and hot spring pools are shared with other visitors on busy days.
Please inform us of any relevant health conditions at booking, hot springs are not recommended for some medical conditions.
reservation_policy: We understand that travel plans may change. Cancellations made 7 or more days before the tour date receive a full refund. Cancellations made between 48 hours and 6 days before receive a 50% refund. Cancellations made less than 48 hours before are not eligible for a refund, although exceptional situations may be reviewed individually.
No-show reservations are charged in full. Guests are granted up to 1 hour after the scheduled pickup time before a no-show is recorded.
Tour rescheduling must be requested at least 24 hours in advance.

faq.question: Is this a private tour?
faq.answer: Yes. Your Wild Papagayo experience is reserved exclusively for your group, private vehicle and private guide, no shared buses or other travelers added to your group.

faq.question: Is hotel pickup included?
faq.answer: Yes. Private pickup and return are included from Papagayo, Playa Hermosa and Playas del Coco. Pickup from other Guanacaste areas is available, exact pricing depends on your hotel location.

faq.question: How much does this tour cost?
faq.answer: Starting from $235 per person for groups of 4+, with final pricing confirmed based on your pickup zone and group size. Contact us on WhatsApp for an exact quote.

faq.question: Is hiking required?
faq.answer: No, access to both the waterfall and the hot springs is short and easy, with no technical hiking required.

faq.question: Can children participate?
faq.answer: Yes, this tour is suitable for all ages.

faq.question: What should I bring?
faq.answer: A swimsuit, towel, water shoes or sandals with grip, and a change of clothes, you'll be in the water at both stops.

faq.question: Can I cancel my reservation?
faq.answer: Yes. Cancellations made 7 or more days before the tour date receive a full refund, and cancellations made 48 hours to 6 days before receive a 50% refund. See our full reservation policy below.
